# coolify_secret_manager_source (Resource)

Links a Coolify application, service, or database to one Doppler, Infisical, or Vault integration token. Requires Coolify >= v4.6.0. There is one source per parent. Create and update send PATCH, then read the source back. Destroy removes the link and leaves environment variables and the integration token in place. Put {{vault.KEY}} references on coolify_environment_variable. Changing the parent forces a new resource. Changing the token or settings updates in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_secret_manager_source" "app" {
  application_uuid       = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"
  integration_token_uuid = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

  infisical_project_id  = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
  infisical_environment = "prod"
  infisical_secret_path = "/app"
}

resource "coolify_environment_variable" "api_key" {
  application_uuid = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"
  key              = "API_KEY"
  value            = "{{vault.API_KEY}}"

  depends_on = [coolify_secret_manager_source.app]
}

resource "coolify_secret_manager_source" "doppler_account" {
  service_uuid           = "ffffffff-ffff-4fff-8fff-ffffffffffff"
  integration_token_uuid = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
  doppler_project        = "website"
  doppler_config         = "production"
}

# A Doppler service token (dp.st.) stores no project or config.
resource "coolify_secret_manager_source" "doppler_token" {
  database_uuid          = "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"
  integration_token_uuid = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
}

resource "coolify_secret_manager_source" "vault" {
  application_uuid       = "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd"
  integration_token_uuid = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
  vault_mount            = "secret"
  vault_path             = "my-app/production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_token_uuid` (String) UUID of a Doppler, Infisical, or Vault token from coolify_integration_token. The token must have the secrets capability. Updated in place.

### Optional

- `application_uuid` (String) Application UUID. Exactly one of application_uuid, service_uuid, or database_uuid must be set. Changing this forces a new resource. A service application UUID is not a parent.
- `database_uuid` (String) Database UUID. Exactly one parent UUID must be set. Changing this forces a new resource. The API path is /databases/{uuid}/secret-manager for every database type.
- `doppler_config` (String) Doppler config, such as production. Required with doppler_project for a service account token.
- `doppler_project` (String) Doppler project. Required with doppler_config for a service account token (dp.sa.). Omit both for a service token (dp.st.). If Coolify does not store this, apply fails instead of clearing it.
- `infisical_environment` (String) Infisical environment slug, such as prod. Required with infisical_project_id.
- `infisical_project_id` (String) Infisical project id. Required with infisical_environment. Do not set Doppler or Vault settings on the same resource.
- `infisical_secret_path` (String) Infisical secret path. Optional. Coolify reads / when this is omitted. Setting / stores / and is a different value.
- `service_uuid` (String) Compose service UUID from coolify_service. Exactly one parent UUID must be set. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `vault_mount` (String) Vault mount. Required with vault_path. Coolify's fetch default of secret does not apply on write.
- `vault_path` (String) Vault secret path. Required with vault_mount.

### Read-Only

- `integration_provider` (String) Provider of the linked token: doppler, infisical, or vault. Coolify's API field is provider. Computed. Stays in the plan while integration_token_uuid is unchanged.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coolify_secret_manager_source.app application:cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc
```
